children: South Korea's exports surged 105.4% in the first 20 days of this month from a year earlier, led by record chip sales driven by global AI investment, customs data showed on Wednesday.
On a working-day average basis, exports were up 65.9% at a record $4.74 billion.
Exports of semiconductors rose 222.5%, accounting for 44.7% of the total.
Last month, exports rose 83.7%, the biggest jump since February 1974, with the monthly value topping $120 billion for the first time.
